title.en: Casino Control (Exemption from Responsible Gambling Requirements) Order 2013

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Casino Control (Exemption from Responsible Gambling Requirements) Order 2013 and shall come into operation on 31st May 2013.
3. Subject to paragraphs 4 and 5, section 170B of the Act shall not apply to, and in relation to, the casino of a casino operator.

4. The exemption in paragraph 3 is subject to the condition that a casino operator submits to the Authority for approval under section 170B of the Act a responsible gambling programme for its casino not later than 1st July 2013, or any other later date (not later than 1st January 2014) as the Authority may specify.

5. The exemption in paragraph 3 shall continue until —
(a)the Authority approves under section 170B of the Act, the casino operator’s responsible gambling programme for its casino submitted under paragraph 4; or
(b)1st January 2014,
whichever occurs first.
